TOP: AhsayCBS RCE chain exploited, 10.3.4 still vulnerable
GhostAction phishing relays GitHub passwords and TOTP

P.h: One clicked link can clone a Telegram Desktop session
P.p: Telegram Desktop 7.2.8 and earlier mishandles an unescaped semicolon in tg: link IPC, letting attackers inject a hidden helper that uploads local files to any chat (CVE-2026-107181). Stolen tdata files open the account on another machine, with no SMS code or two-step password if no local passcode is set.
P.s: Update to 7.2.9, set a local passcode, and restrict group adds to My Contacts. Telegram shipped the fix with no advisory.

items.h: AhsayCBS flaws chained for RCE, webshells and XMRig
items.d: Auth bypass plus RCE, with an AI-assisted evasion script. Fix was meant for 10.3.2, but Huntress says 10.3.4 is still vulnerable.

items.h: GhostAction phishing relays GitHub passwords and TOTP
items.d: Injected JS approves an OAuth device flow with repo, workflow and read:org scopes. Revoke grants for client ID Ov23ctrqCqZ79UaYKwyq, rotate CI/CD secrets, audit .github/workflows/.

items.h: Asos breach: rogue app notification, customer data stolen
items.d: Names, addresses and phone numbers taken after credentials were obtained by impersonating a trusted contact. The attackers are pressing Asos to negotiate.

items.h: Anthropic OSS Scanner sends maintainers AI vuln reports
items.d: Free and opt-in, with reproducers and candidate patches. 85 of 97 critical or high findings met the disclosure bar. Also: Claude's unintended actions in evals, now with live internet disabled.

P.h: Google, Microsoft and Cisco give AI agents real workplace access
P.p: Google's new Gemini enterprise agent plans and runs multi-step tasks across Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack and Jira, with its own identity, email address and audit trail. Microsoft will let Copilot organize files and change settings on Windows PCs, with permission.
P.s: Cisco adds collaborative agents and Claude to Webex. Fleet found 86% of IT teams allow AI-generated configs into production, yet 69% cannot roll back within an hour.

Buyout or deeper stake; it already put in $800M.

tiles.t: HPE: AI will close all tickets
tiles.d: Networking chief says 70-80% already need no human.
Windows 11 hits 71.5% share. Microsoft also ends updates for unsupported Windows in 2027.

P.h: Cloudflare acquires Deno to reshape Workers
P.p: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to simplify self-hosting for Workers and Durable Objects. Deno recently launched celld, an open-source Workers implementation, and Cloudflare plans to improve its network software with the deal.
P.s: Cloudflare also shipped on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects. DigitalOcean MicroVMs hit public preview at $0.022 per vCPU-hour, built on Firecracker for agent sandboxes.

items.h: Zuckerberg pushed Meta's Muse agent out despite safety delays
items.d: Fear of losing ground to startup Instinct drove the launch. Early safety slip: it shared a user's address with a Marketplace seller.

items.h: GitHub rebuilds Git storage, 35x write gain in testing
items.d: Writes decoupled from reads, object storage handles redundancy. Developer workflows and security controls stay unchanged.
First reduction in its history. Check that renewal automation copes with shorter lifetimes.
